title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-Inch Solid Brass Hook | 2-1/2-Inch Hanging Space | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-Inch Hook
description:
Add space-saving hanging storage with a retractable hooks and garment rod designed for crisp, modern bathroom hardware. This wall mount solid brass hook pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in to stay out of the way.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod provides 2-1/2" of hanging space when extended
- Wall-mounted installation helps save floor space
- Holds up to 15 lb for towels, robes, coats, and everyday items
- Customizable tip: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- All mounting hardware included; fits standard interior walls

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; 1" projection
- Installation: Drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around it; uses 6/32 toggles
- Assembly required: No
- Finish options: available in 28 designer finishes including statement colors such as unlacquered brass, antique pewter, fire engine red, pink, and autumn sparkle

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
